title: DECODE: Diagnosing Interpretability Failures in Automated Interpretation Process
abstract: arXiv:2611.17856v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tools for interpreting the internal representations of Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on LLMs themselves to both generate and evaluate explanations, creating a self-referential automated interpretation process with minimal human oversight. This automation raises significant reliability concerns, which are exacerbated by the absence of ground truth. In practice, it is difficult to validate explanations or to attribute interpretability failures to their source -- whether they originate from the tool's extracted representations or from the LLM used in the process. To address these challenges, we present DECODE, a visual analytics system that reintroduces human oversight into the automated interpretation process. Our approach decomposes the diagnostic workflow into three progressive stages, isolating failure sources ranging from structural defects to explanation-level misalignments. translated_title: DECODE：诊断自动化解释过程中的可解释性失效
translated_abstract: 用于解释大语言模型（LLM）内部表示的工具越来越多地依赖大语言模型本身来生成和评估解释，从而形成了一个几乎无需人工监督的自指式自动化解释过程。这种自动化引发了显著的可靠性问题，而由于缺乏真值标准，这些问题被进一步加剧。在实际应用中，人们很难验证解释的有效性，也难以将可解释性失效归因于其源头——即失效究竟源自工具所提取的表示，还是源自该过程中所使用的大语言模型。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了DECODE，一个将人类监督重新引入自动化解释过程的可视分析系统。我们的方法将诊断工作流分解为三个渐进的阶段，从而隔离出从结构性缺陷到解释层面失配等多种失效来源。受编码者间一致性……
tldr: 提出DECODE可视分析系统，通过将诊断流程分解为三个渐进阶段，重新引入人类监督，帮助隔离和定位自动化解释过程中可解释性失效的来源。
en_tdlr: DECODE is a visual analytics system that reintroduces human oversight into the automated LLM interpretation process by decomposing diagnosis into three progressive stages to isolate sources of interpretability failures.
